intro a
  have heq : (fun n => (v n*a-a*v n).val Ω) =
      (fun n => -((a*v n-v n*a).val Ω)) := by
    funext n
    simp only [AddSubgroupClass.coe_sub,sub_apply,neg_sub]
  rw [heq]
  simpa only [neg_zero] using (hcentral a Ω).neg
findings.problem: The single-use function equality and its extensionality proof only normalize the sign of the commutator. The same normalization can be performed directly on the negated convergence statement.
findings.proposed_change:
Replace lines 50–56 with:
  intro a
  simpa only [AddSubgroupClass.coe_sub, sub_apply, neg_sub, neg_zero] using
    (hcentral a Ω).neg
findings.benefit: Removes an intermediate equality and rewrite while keeping the mathematical idea explicit: reversing a commutator negates it, preserving convergence to zero. No extra assumptions on the vectors or parameter are needed.
